#include <cstdint>

template<size_t buffer_size = 1024>
std::vector<uint8_t> preview_buffer_data(const hexi::static_buffer<std::byte, buffer_size>& buffer, size_t bytes_to_preview) {
    // Determine how many bytes we can actually preview (capped by available data)
    size_t available = buffer.available();
    size_t to_copy = std::min(bytes_to_preview, available);

    std::vector<uint8_t> result;
    result.reserve(to_copy);

    size_t read_idx = buffer.read_index();
    size_t buffer_capacity = buffer.size();
    size_t first_chunk = std::min(to_copy, buffer_capacity - read_idx);

    // Get pointer to the underlying buffer
    const std::byte* buffer_data = buffer.data();

    // Copy first chunk (from read index to end of buffer, or less if we don't need that much)
    for (size_t i = 0; i < first_chunk; ++i) {
        result.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(buffer_data[read_idx + i]));
    }

    // If we need more, copy from the beginning of the buffer
    if (first_chunk < to_copy) {
        size_t second_chunk = to_copy - first_chunk;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < second_chunk; ++i) {
            result.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(buffer_data[i]));
        }
    }

    return result;
}

inline DepthOrderingSnapshot test_observer_depth_ordering() {
    // 1. Define DepthProbeNode class
    class DepthProbeNode : public reaction::ObserverNode {
    public:
        DepthProbeNode() = default;
        using reaction::ObserverNode::ObserverNode;
    };

    // 2. Get thread manager instance
    auto& tm = reaction::ThreadManager::getInstance();

    // 3. Reset thread manager state
    tm.resetState();

    // 4. Enable thread safety
    tm.enableThreadSafety();

    // 5. Create shallow and deep DepthProbeNode instances
    auto shallow = std::make_shared<DepthProbeNode>();
    auto deep = std::make_shared<DepthProbeNode>();

    // 6. Create NodeWeak from nodes
    reaction::NodeWeak weakShallow(shallow);
    reaction::NodeWeak weakDeep(deep);

    // 7. Create BatchCompare instance
    reaction::BatchCompare comparator;

    // 8. Compare initial nodes
    bool initialComparatorResult = comparator(weakShallow, weakDeep);

    // 9. Update depths of nodes
    shallow->updateDepth(1);
    deep->updateDepth(2);

    // 10. Compare shallow before deep
    bool shallowBeforeDeep = comparator(weakShallow, weakDeep);

    // 11. Update depth of shallow node again
    shallow->updateDepth(3);

    // 12. Compare deep before shallow
    bool deepBeforeShallow = comparator(weakDeep, weakShallow);

    // 13. Create null NodeWeak
    reaction::NodeWeak nullWeak;

    // 14. Compare null with shallow
    bool nullComesFirst = comparator(nullWeak, weakShallow);

    // 15. Return depth ordering snapshot
    return DepthOrderingSnapshot{
        initialComparatorResult,
        shallowBeforeDeep,
        deepBeforeShallow,
        nullComesFirst
    };
}

    auto stmt = db.prepare(R"(

        FROM Customer c
        JOIN "Order" o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
        JOIN OrderItem oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
        JOIN Product p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id

  // Create a connection to a temporary SQLite database (in memory)
  sqlgen::sqlite::connection conn(":memory:");

  // Define the Product table
  sqlgen::table<Product> product_table("Product");

  // Create the table

  // Insert the products
  for (const auto& product : products) {
    conn.execute(sqlgen::insert(product_table, product));
  }

  // Build the SELECT query
  auto query = sqlgen::select(
    product_table.product_id,
    product_table.name,
    sqlgen::abs(product_table.price).as("abs_price"),
    sqlgen::ceil(product_table.price).as("ceil_price"),
    sqlgen::floor(product_table.price).as("floor_price"),
    sqlgen::round(product_table.price, 2).as("rounded_price"),
    sqlgen::exp(product_table.discount_rate / 100.0).as("exp_discount"),
    sqlgen::ln(product_table.price).as("ln_price"),
    sqlgen::log2(product_table.quantity).as("log2_quantity"),
    sqlgen::sin(product_table.discount_rate).as("sin_discount"),
    sqlgen::cos(product_table.discount_rate).as("cos_discount"),
    sqlgen::tan(product_table.discount_rate).as("tan_discount"),
    sqlgen::sqrt(product_table.quantity).as("sqrt_quantity")
  ).from(product_table);

  // Execute the query and get the results
  auto results = conn.query<MathAnalysis>(query);

  return results;
}
